senses.definitionCN: 连接不同群体、而非只把每个群体绑在自身内部的纽带
senses.example: Bridging social cohesion grew where the two neighbourhoods shared a market.
senses.exampleCN: 当两个街区共用一个市场时，桥接型社会凝聚力增长了。
senses.why: A tightly knit group can be hostile to outsiders; this sense asks whether the bonds run between groups as well as within them.
senses.whyCN: 紧密团结的群体可能敌视外人；这个义项追问纽带是否也跨群体延伸，而不只在群体内部。

intro.en: Social comes from Latin socialis 'of companions', from socius 'ally'. Cohesion comes from Latin cohaesus, past participle of cohaerere 'to stick together', from com- 'together' plus haerere 'to cling'. The English phrase is modern. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: social 来自拉丁 socialis「同伴的」，词根 socius「盟友」。cohesion 来自拉丁 cohaesus，即 cohaerere「黏在一起」的过去分词，由表示「共同」的前缀加 haerere「附着」构成。这个英语词组是现代的。年代均为约数。

items.en: Socius meant 'companion, ally'. A link with a root meaning 'to follow' has been suggested, but it remains a hypothesis rather than a proved derivation.
items.cn: socius 意为「同伴、盟友」。有人提出它与一个意为「跟随」的词根有关，但那只是假说，并非已证实的派生。

items.en: Haerere meant 'to stick, cling, be attached'. It also gives adhere and hesitation, where the sense of being stuck becomes a pause.
items.cn: haerere 意为「黏住、附着、贴住」。它还给出 adhere 与 hesitation，其中「被粘住」的意思转成了「迟疑」。

items.en: Cohaerere 'to stick together' adds com- 'together' to haerere; its participle cohaesus gave the noun cohaesio and English cohesion.
items.cn: cohaerere「黏在一起」在 haerere 前加表示「共同」的前缀；其分词 cohaesus 给出名词 cohaesio 与英语 cohesion。

items.en: Durkheim used cohesion for the force that keeps differentiated individuals in one society, contrasting mechanical and organic solidarity.
items.cn: 涂尔干用 cohesion 指使分化个体留在同一社会中的力量，并区分机械团结与有机团结。

items.en: In the late twentieth century social cohesion became a policy term tied to social capital, inclusion and urban renewal.
items.cn: 二十世纪后期，social cohesion 成为与社会资本、融合与城市更新相联系的政策术语。

items.en: Source uncertain: the pre-Latin origin of socius is unresolved, and the phrase has no single coinage date; its policy sense emerged gradually.
items.cn: 来源不确定：socius 在拉丁语之前的来源未有定论；这个词组没有单一造词年代，其政策含义是逐渐形成的。

note.en: Group one separates words sharing the stick-together root; group two holds related social-bond terms.
note.cn: 第一组区分共享「黏住」词根的词；第二组是相关的社会纽带术语。

entries.definition: Sticking together of any kind, physical or social; the phrase limits it to a society.
entries.definitionCN: 任何形式的黏合，物理的或社会的；这个词组把它限定到社会。

entries.definition: Logical consistency, especially of a text or argument; it shares the root but means intelligibility rather than unity.
entries.definitionCN: 逻辑上的一致性，尤指文本或论证；同根，却指可理解性而非团结。

entries.definition: The sticking of one surface to another; the prefix changes from 'together' to 'to'.
entries.definitionCN: 一个表面附着到另一个表面；前缀从「共同」变成「朝向」。

entries.definition: Of society; alone it can describe a party or an insect.
entries.definitionCN: 社会的；单用时也可形容聚会或昆虫。

entries.definition: Active mutual support among people; it is the practised side of cohesion.
entries.definitionCN: 人们之间主动的相互支持；它是凝聚力被实践的一面。

entries.definition: The trust and contacts that can be used as a resource; it is a component often measured instead of cohesion.
entries.definitionCN: 可当作资源使用的信任与人脉；它常作为凝聚力的替代测量成分。

entries.definition: The process of bringing newcomers into a society; it is one route to cohesion, not cohesion itself.
entries.definitionCN: 把新来者纳入社会的过程；它是通向凝聚力的一条路径，而非凝聚力本身。

entries.definition: Making institutions open to all; it is a policy means whose end is often stated as cohesion.
entries.definitionCN: 让制度对所有人开放；它是政策手段，其目的常被表述为凝聚力。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real Latin verbs, real sociological terms and real policy phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的拉丁动词、真实的社会学术语与真实的政策说法。

normal.en: Cohesion is sticking together; social cohesion is a whole society sticking together.
normal.cn: cohesion 是黏在一起；社会凝聚力是整个社会黏在一起。

normal.en: The same root gives adhere and hesitation, where being stuck becomes a pause.
normal.cn: 同一词根给出 adhere 与 hesitation，其中「被粘住」变成了「停顿」。

normal.en: Durkheim asked the classic question: what keeps divided people in one society?
normal.cn: 涂尔干问的是经典问题：是什么让分工的人留在同一个社会？

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the policy field: strengthen social cohesion, social cohesion policy, the erosion of social cohesion.
normal.cn: 固定说法标出政策领域：增强社会凝聚力、社会凝聚力政策、社会凝聚力的侵蚀。

normal.en: The phrase is uncountable: one speaks of more or less cohesion, not of cohesions.
normal.cn: 这个词组不可数：说凝聚力多或少，而不说「几个凝聚力」。

abstract.en: Picture a net of thin lines joining yards whose owners have never met.
abstract.cn: 想象一张细线组成的网，连着主人彼此从未见过的院子。

abstract.en: Picture trust as a bridge that must be walked on before it can be seen.
abstract.cn: 想象信任是一座桥，必须先走上去才看得见。

abstract.en: Picture two tightly knit groups whose inner bonds make them hostile to each other.
abstract.cn: 想象两个紧密团结的群体，内部纽带越强，彼此越敌视。

examples.en: Unemployment is often described as a threat to social cohesion.
examples.cn: 失业常被描述为对社会凝聚力的威胁。

examples.en: The report measured social cohesion by trust in neighbours and in courts.
examples.cn: 报告通过对邻居与对法庭的信任来测量社会凝聚力。

examples.en: Shared public space did more for social cohesion than any slogan.
examples.cn: 共享的公共空间对社会凝聚力的作用胜过任何口号。

dict_mnemonic.text: social（同伴的）+ cohesion（黏在一起）＝ 一个社会的成员彼此黏住的程度；记「细线绷紧，陌生人点头」。

root: social 源自拉丁 socialis「同伴的」，词根 socius 意为「盟友」，更早来源不确定；cohesion 源自拉丁 cohaerere「黏在一起」的过去分词 cohaesus，该动词由前缀表「共同」加 haerere「附着」构成。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses move from overall glue to shared norms, the classic sociological question, policy target, index, ethnic dimension, solidarity and bridging ties.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从整体黏合，移到共享规范、经典社会学问题、政策目标、指数、族群维度、团结与桥接纽带。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: thin lines joining many yards into one net.
core.cn: 核心意象：细线把许多院子连成一张网。

branches.en: GLUE AND PEACE: the total strength of ties, and what keeps a quarrel from becoming a split.
branches.cn: 黏合与和平：纽带的总强度，以及防止争吵变成分裂的力量。

branches.en: NORMS AND THE CLASSIC QUESTION: expectations of behaviour, and how separate people remain one society.
branches.cn: 规范与经典问题：对行为的期待，以及分开的人如何仍是一个社会。

branches.en: TARGET AND INDEX: an aim written into plans, and a score built from surveys.
branches.cn: 目标与指数：写进规划的目的，以及由调查合成的分数。

branches.en: THE TEST OF DIVERSITY: can groups share institutions without sharing a history?
branches.cn: 多样性的检验：群体能否共享制度而不共享历史？

branches.en: BRIDGES, NOT ONLY WALLS: ties that run between groups as well as within them.
branches.cn: 是桥而不只是墙：纽带既在群体内部，也跨群体延伸。

intro.en: The phrase joins a Latin adjective of companionship to a Latin noun of sticking together; both halves remain productive.
intro.cn: 这个词组把表示「同伴关系」的拉丁形容词与表示「黏合」的拉丁名词结合起来，两半都仍有构词能力。

latinIntro.en: Socius and socialis supply the first element; com- plus haerere, through cohaerere and cohaesus, supply the second. No Greek element is involved.
latinIntro.cn: socius 与 socialis 提供前一成分；表示「共同」的前缀加 haerere，经 cohaerere 与 cohaesus 提供后一成分。这个词组不含希腊成分。

items.example: The argument coheres only if the terms are fixed.
items.exampleCN: 只有术语固定，这个论证才连贯。

items.example: Cohesion keeps the group from splitting.
items.exampleCN: 凝聚力使群体不致分裂。

items.example: The team became more cohesive after the loss.
items.exampleCN: 失利之后，这支队伍变得更有凝聚力。

items.example: The report is coherent from start to finish.
items.exampleCN: 这份报告从头到尾都连贯。

items.meaning: to stick to a surface or a rule
items.example: The label adheres to the glass.
items.exampleCN: 标签粘在玻璃上。

items.example: Adhesion was tested in wet conditions.
items.exampleCN: 在潮湿条件下测试了黏附力。

items.example: Social ties weakened after the factory closed.
items.exampleCN: 工厂关闭后，社会纽带变弱了。

items.example: The town is socially divided.
items.exampleCN: 这座镇子在社会层面是分裂的。

definition_zh: 黏合力；凝聚力；（语言学）篇章衔接；（群体）团结
definition_en: the force or quality by which parts stick together, whether molecules, group members or sentences
core_image: 细管里的水柱被自己内部的力量拉住，高出杯口也不落下
scene: 把细管插进水里，水柱自己爬了上来，高出杯口却不肯落下。Water climbs the narrow tube because cohesion holds the molecules together.
sceneCN: 这里 cohesion 指物质内部分子彼此黏合的力量（第 1 个义项：物理黏合力）；句意为水能爬上细管，是因为黏合力把分子拉在一起。

pos.zh: 黏合力；凝聚力（不可数，指黏合的状态或力量）
（语言学）衔接（不可数，指篇章内部的连接关系）

derivatives.zh: 黏合；连贯（由拉丁 cohaerere「黏在一起」进入，核心是「彼此附着」，是本词的基础动词）
有黏合力的；有凝聚力的（由「凝聚力」一词的形容词形式而来，由状态转指性质）
连贯的；一致的（由拉丁词根加表共同的前缀，构成另一形容词形式，由「粘住」转指「说得通」）
连贯性（由基础形容词加表状态的名词后缀而来，由性质转指状态，常与 cohesion 对照）
黏附（由拉丁词根加表朝向的前缀而来，由「黏住」转为「附着到别的表面」）

senses.title: Physical sticking
senses.definition: the attraction that holds molecules of the same substance together
senses.definitionCN: 把同种物质的分子拉在一起的那种吸引力
senses.example: Cohesion pulls the water into a rounded drop on the leaf.
senses.exampleCN: 黏合力把水在叶面上拉成一颗圆润的水珠。
senses.why: The oldest sense is literal: things of one kind cling to one another, as water molecules do.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项是字面的：同类之物彼此附着，就像水分子那样。

senses.title: Social unity
senses.definition: the strength of the bonds that keep a community or society together
senses.definitionCN: 使一个共同体或社会保持一体的纽带强度
senses.example: Cohesion in the village survived the closure of the mine.
senses.exampleCN: 矿井关闭之后，村子里的凝聚力仍然存在。
senses.why: The physical image transfers to people: what holds molecules together becomes what holds neighbours together.
senses.whyCN: 物理意象被移用到人身上：把分子拉住的力量，变成把邻里拉住的力量。

senses.title: Group and team cohesion
senses.definition: the degree to which members of a group are attached to it and to one another
senses.definitionCN: 一个群体的成员对群体及彼此依附的程度
senses.example: The coach measured cohesion before the final match.
senses.exampleCN: 教练在决赛前测量了团队凝聚力。
senses.why: Psychology made cohesion a variable: something a group can have more or less of, and something that can be built.
senses.whyCN: 心理学把凝聚力变成变量：一个群体可以多一点或少一点，也可以被刻意建设。

senses.title: Textual cohesion
senses.definition: the ties of reference, substitution and conjunction that make a text hold together
senses.definitionCN: 由照应、替代与连接构成、使篇章连成一体的各种联系
senses.example: Cohesion in the paragraph comes from repeated pronouns and linkers.
senses.exampleCN: 这一段的衔接来自重复出现的代词与连接词。
senses.why: Linguists borrowed the word for the surface links between sentences: text also has a kind of glue.
senses.whyCN: 语言学者借用了这个词来表示句子之间的表面连接：文本也有一种黏合剂。

senses.title: Cohesive devices
senses.definition: the specific words and structures, such as pronouns and ellipsis, that create those ties
senses.definitionCN: 造成这些联系的具体词与结构，如代词与省略
senses.example: The essay lists cohesion devices before it asks students to write.
senses.exampleCN: 这篇文章先列出衔接手段，再让学生动笔。
senses.why: Once the concept exists, it can be broken into parts that teachers can name and test.
senses.whyCN: 概念一旦存在，就能被拆成教师可以命名与检测的部件。

senses.title: Cohesion versus coherence
senses.definition: the difference between surface links and the underlying sense that a text makes
senses.definitionCN: 表面连接与文本整体说得通这层意思之间的区别
senses.example: The paragraph has cohesion but no coherence: the links lead nowhere.
senses.exampleCN: 这段有衔接却没有连贯：连接词通向不了任何地方。
senses.why: Glue is not meaning; a text can be tightly linked and still say nothing, so the pair must be distinguished.
senses.whyCN: 胶水不等于意义；文本可以连接紧密却什么也没说，因此必须区分这两个概念。

senses.title: Alliance cohesion
senses.definition: the willingness of partners or coalition members to stay together under disagreement
senses.definitionCN: 伙伴或联盟成员在分歧之下仍愿意留在一起的程度
senses.example: Cohesion among the allies weakened when the funding ended.
senses.exampleCN: 资金终止后，盟友之间的凝聚力削弱了。
senses.why: Politics applies the word to agreements between bodies, where unity is tested by competing interests.
senses.whyCN: 政治把这个词用到团体间的协议上，其团结受到彼此竞争的利益的检验。

senses.title: A measured target
senses.definition: an index or policy aim expressing how united a group or society should be
senses.definitionCN: 表达一个群体或社会应有多团结的指数或政策目标
senses.example: The programme reports cohesion as a score for each district.
senses.exampleCN: 该项目把凝聚力作为每个城区的分数来报告。
senses.why: Measurement turns a bond into a number, and a number can become a target to be managed.
senses.whyCN: 测量把纽带变成数字，而数字可以变成被管理的目标。

intro.en: Cohesion comes from Latin cohaesus, the past participle of cohaerere 'to stick together', built on com- 'together' and haerere 'to cling'. English borrowed the noun in the seventeenth century. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: cohesion 来自拉丁 cohaesus，即 cohaerere「黏在一起」的过去分词，由表示「共同」的前缀加 haerere「附着」构成。英语在十七世纪借入这个名词。年代均为约数。

items.en: Haerere meant 'to stick, cling, be fixed'. It also lies behind adhere and hesitation, where being stuck turns into a pause.
items.cn: haerere 意为「黏住、附着、固定」。它也是 adhere 与 hesitation 的来源，其中「被粘住」转成了「停顿」。

items.en: Cohaerere added com- 'together' to haerere, giving 'to stick together, be connected'. Its participle is cohaesus.
items.cn: cohaerere 在 haerere 前加表示「共同」的前缀，得到「黏在一起、相互连接」。其分词是 cohaesus。

items.en: The noun cohaesio named the state of being stuck together; it could describe both bodies and arguments.
items.cn: 名词 cohaesio 命名黏在一起的状态，既能描述物体，也能描述论证。

items.en: English cohesion appears in the seventeenth century, first in physical and philosophical writing, then in social description.
items.cn: 英语 cohesion 在十七世纪出现，先见于物理与哲学写作，后进入社会描述。

items.en: Halliday and Hasan made cohesion a central term of text linguistics in 1976, listing reference, substitution, ellipsis, conjunction and lexical ties.
items.cn: 韩礼德与哈桑在一九七六年把 cohesion 变成篇章语言学的核心术语，列出照应、替代、省略、连接与词汇衔接。

items.en: Source uncertain: the pre-Latin origin of haerere is not established, and the exact date of the English noun's first use varies between dictionaries.
items.cn: 来源不确定：haerere 在拉丁语之前的来源未得到证明；这个英语名词首次使用的确切年代，各词典说法不一。

note.en: Group one separates words built on the same stick root; group two holds terms for unity and connection.
note.cn: 第一组区分同一「黏住」词根的词；第二组是团结与连接的术语。

entries.definition: Logical consistency, especially of an argument or text; it is about intelligibility, not glue.
entries.definitionCN: 逻辑上的一致性，尤指论证或文本；它关乎可理解性，而非黏合。

entries.definition: Attachment of one substance to a different surface; the prefix means 'to', not 'together'.
entries.definitionCN: 一种物质附着到另一种表面；前缀意为「朝向」，而非「共同」。

entries.definition: Holding together; it describes the quality, while cohesion names the state or force.
entries.definitionCN: 有黏合力的；形容词描述性质，cohesion 命名状态或力量。

entries.definition: To hold together or be consistent; it names the process that cohesion results from.
entries.definitionCN: 黏合；前后一致。它命名产生凝聚力的过程。

entries.definition: Active support among people with shared interests; it is cohesion in action.
entries.definitionCN: 有共同利益者之间的主动支持；它是行动中的凝聚力。

entries.definition: The state of being one whole; it is broader and less mechanical than cohesion.
entries.definitionCN: 成为一个整体的状态；比凝聚力更宽，也更少机械意味。

entries.definition: The process of combining parts into one system; cohesion is the resulting hold, integration is the making.
entries.definitionCN: 把部分合成一个系统的过程；凝聚力是结果性的黏合，整合是制造过程。

entries.definition: Agreement of parts with one standard over time; it concerns regularity rather than sticking.
entries.definitionCN: 各部分长期符合同一标准；它关乎规律性，而非黏合。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real Latin verb, its real relatives and real technical uses.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的拉丁动词、其真实同族词与真实的技术用法。

normal.en: Cohesion is sticking together; adhesion is sticking to something else.
normal.cn: cohesion 是黏在一起；adhesion 是黏到别的东西上。

normal.en: The family runs cohere, cohesion, cohesive, coherent, coherence.
normal.cn: 词族包括 cohere、cohesion、cohesive、coherent、coherence。

normal.en: Cohesion is glue, coherence is sense: a text can have one without the other.
normal.cn: cohesion 是胶水，coherence 是意义：文本可以有其一而无其二。

normal.en: Fixed phrases show the range: social cohesion, group cohesion, cohesion and coherence, molecular cohesion.
normal.cn: 固定说法标出范围：社会凝聚力、群体凝聚力、衔接与连贯、分子黏合力。

normal.en: The noun is uncountable: more cohesion, less cohesion, never 'cohesions'.
normal.cn: 这个名词不可数：凝聚力多一些、少一些，不说「几个凝聚力」。

abstract.en: Picture water rising in a narrow tube because it holds on to itself.
abstract.cn: 想象水在细管里上升，因为它拉住了自己。

abstract.en: Picture a paragraph whose pronouns all point back to one another and to nothing else.
abstract.cn: 想象一段文字，所有代词都指回彼此，却不指向任何别的什么。

abstract.en: Picture an alliance held together only by the funding that is about to end.
abstract.cn: 想象一个联盟，只靠那笔即将终止的资金维系。

examples.en: Surface tension and cohesion explain why the insect can walk on water.
examples.cn: 表面张力与黏合力解释了昆虫为何能在水面上行走。

examples.en: The teacher marked cohesion separately from argument.
examples.cn: 老师把衔接与论证分开评分。

examples.en: Economic shock can destroy the cohesion of a small town in a single year.
examples.cn: 经济冲击能在一年之内摧毁一个小镇的凝聚力。

dict_mnemonic.text: co-（共同）+ haerere（黏住）+ -sion（状态）＝ 彼此黏住的状态；记「水爬细管，字连成段」。

root: 源自拉丁 cohaerere「黏在一起」的过去分词 cohaesus，再由名词 cohaesio 进入英语；该动词由前缀表「共同」加 haerere「附着」构成，haerere 更早来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses move from molecular attraction to social unity, team psychology, textual ties, cohesive devices, the contrast with coherence, alliance politics and measured targets.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从分子吸引，移到社会团结、团队心理、篇章联系、衔接手段、与连贯的对照、联盟政治与被测量的目标。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: water holding itself up inside a narrow tube.
core.cn: 核心意象：水在细管里把自己托住。

branches.en: MOLECULES: the literal attraction of like to like.
branches.cn: 分子：同类相吸的字面力量。

branches.en: PEOPLE AND PARTNERS: neighbours held together, and allies held through disagreement.
branches.cn: 邻里与伙伴：被拉住邻里，以及在分歧中仍被拉住的盟友。

branches.en: THE TEAM: cohesion becomes a variable a coach can build and measure.
branches.cn: 团队：凝聚力变成教练可以建设与测量的变量。

branches.en: THE TEXT: surface links between sentences, then the named devices that create them.
branches.cn: 文本：句子之间的表面连接，再是造成这些连接的具名手段。

branches.en: GLUE VERSUS SENSE, AND THE SCORE: links without meaning, and a bond turned into a number.
branches.cn: 胶水与意义，以及分数：没有意义的连接，和被变成数字的纽带。

intro.en: Cohesion is a Latin noun of sticking; its stem builds a compact family of verbs, adjectives and nouns.
intro.cn: cohesion 是表示「黏合」的拉丁名词；其词干构成一个紧凑的动词、形容词与名词词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin com- and haerere, through cohaerere and cohaesus, supply every morpheme. The related ad- form gives adhesion.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁表示「共同」的前缀与 haerere，经 cohaerere 与 cohaesus，提供全部语素。相关的表示「朝向」的形式给出 adhesion。

items.example: The chapters cohere around one question.
items.exampleCN: 各章围绕一个问题连成一体。

items.example: Cohesion depends on shared rituals.
items.exampleCN: 凝聚力依赖共享仪式。

items.example: The group remained cohesive under pressure.
items.exampleCN: 这个群体在压力下仍保持凝聚。

items.example: She gave a coherent account of the night.
items.exampleCN: 她对那晚作了连贯的陈述。

items.example: The essay lacks coherence after page three.
items.exampleCN: 这篇文章从第三页起就缺乏连贯。

items.meaning: to stick to; to follow a rule
items.example: Members adhere to the same code.
items.exampleCN: 成员遵守同一套准则。

items.example: Adhesion failed in the damp air.
items.exampleCN: 在潮湿空气中黏附失效了。

items.example: He answered without hesitation.
items.exampleCN: 他毫不犹豫地回答。
